description:
What has been permitted on a house in Minneapolis or Saint Paul: roofs, additions, electrical, plumbing, demolition, with dates and the contractor of record. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "What permits have been pulled on 4012 Bryant Ave S, Minneapolis?"
- "Was the roof at this Saint Paul house permitted?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: minneapolis: Minneapolis; saint-paul: Saint Paul. Default minneapolis.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: building_permits_at_address
title: Building Permits at an Address
